business_problem: Mercado Libre needed an AI platform that could safely automate complex customer-service mediation and other high-stakes workflows across a massive commerce and fintech environment, not just assist with isolated catalog or review tasks.
solution_summary: Mercado Libre built Verdi as a natural-language-first development platform that lets its 17,000 developers create AI applications across more than 30,000 microservices while keeping security, routing logic, and guardrails built into the platform. Verdi uses GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, and GPT-3.5 Turbo to handle multimodal reasoning, routing, and lightweight tasks, and one of its first major deployments is autonomous customer-service mediation between buyers and sellers. Rather than forcing developers to manage code-level complexity directly, Verdi presents a structured framework of language models, Python nodes, skills, and APIs so teams can compose agentic workflows, including image-based “proof of damage” steps with vision, inter-skill communication, unit testing, and deployment inside Mercado Libre’s internal developer platform. Beyond Verdi, OpenAI models also power inventory expansion, fraud detection, review summarization, product-description localization, and personalized notifications across the broader marketplace.

solution_components.name: Verdi
solution_components.role: Provides the secure internal AI-development platform for building autonomous workflows at Mercado Libre scale.

solution_components.name: GPT-4o
solution_components.role: Handles context-rich and multimodal tasks such as vision-based proof-of-damage analysis and complex workflow reasoning.

solution_components.name: GPT-4o mini
solution_components.role: Powers lightweight tasks such as automated review summaries for product feedback.

solution_components.name: GPT-3.5 Turbo
solution_components.role: Supports translation and other lower-cost language tasks inside the Verdi ecosystem.

data_flow: Marketplace listings, disputes, reviews, images, and customer-service cases flow into Verdi’s skill graph, where GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, and GPT-3.5 Turbo combine with Python nodes and APIs to make decisions, call systems, and return outputs. The same model family also enriches listings, detects fraud, summarizes feedback, and personalizes notifications across the marketplace.
business_outcome: Mercado Libre expanded catalog coverage, improved fraud accuracy, increased order conversion, and began shifting large volumes of customer-service mediation from human operators to an internal AI platform built for secure scale.
